rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance coverage – 1-4 unit properties exempt
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents under its Rent Control Ordinance (Municipal Code Chapter 260), administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt from rent control.
rules.key_value: Rent control applies only to properties with 5 or more units; 1-4 unit properties exempt
rules.citation: Jersey City Municipal Code Chapter 260 (Rent Control Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
rules.coverage_text: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties; other exemptions under the Rent Control Ordinance may be requested via a Rent Control Exemption Request.
rules.extraction_note: Source is an informational city web page, not the ordinance text. The rent increase formula, effective date and enactment date are not stated. The page references a CPI chart, capital improvement and hardship increase applications, and tenant Illegal Rent Petitions, but gives no details. The 1-4 unit exemption applies regardless of owner occupancy, so small owner-occupied buildings are exempt as a subset.
